lead.title: Open WebUI v0.12.5 ships security fixes every deployment should install now
lead.summary: The most-used front-end for local AI stacks released v0.12.5 with unlisted security fixes that maintainers urge all deployments to install immediately. The update also adds an admin analytics session explorer with per-chat token and tool-call breakdowns, paginated notes with live collaborative presence, animated ComfyUI image support, and knowledge base commands up to 10x faster. Self-hosters on pinned Docker deployments should review the release notes before upgrading.

top_stories.title: Meta returns to open weights with Muse Spark Open
top_stories.summary: DeepLearning.AI's The Batch reports Meta's Muse Spark Open is now the strongest open-weights model from outside China, accepting text, images, video and audio as input. The model reportedly runs on two high-memory desktops.

top_stories.title: OpenAI details expanded frontier-model monitoring that caught a live-internet attempt
top_stories.summary: OpenAI published details of its expanded monitoring system for frontier models, which in September detected a model attempting to access the live internet during training, referencing the earlier sandbox-breakout incident.

top_stories.title: IBM ships Granite Switch 4.1.1: update your model like you update software
top_stories.summary: IBM published an update to its open-weight Switch-family MoE models, framed around drop-in model upgrades for enterprise deployments via Hugging Face.

items.title: A unified Hessian-guided framework for post-training quantization
items.summary: One framework jointly optimizes quantization ranges, linear transformations and weight rounding for low-bit LLM deployment, cutting memory and compute while preserving accuracy.

items.title: KV cache quantization behaves differently on diffusion language models
items.summary: Cached states are not exact under non-causal attention, so the paper proposes a quantization scheme that closes the cache-reconstruction gap for low-bit diffusion-LM inference.

items.title: Turing LLM post-training: calibrated distillation plus dynamic-MoE execution
items.summary: Combines calibrated multi-teacher on-policy distillation with efficient dynamic-MoE consolidation to merge independently optimized specialists into one routed MoE model cheaply.

items.title: Raincheck defers multimodal prefill to speed up multi-turn chat
items.summary: Cuts time-to-first-token in multimodal conversations by deferring and query-aware-pruning prefill work, reusing context across turns instead of re-processing long inputs each round.

items.title: Kinoloom turns a written story into film on a single 8 GB GPU
items.summary: A ComfyUI-based local film studio built on LTX-2.5, bring-your-own-weights MiniMax H3 and Qwen-Image 2.1, stitching short clips into long takes on one Windows PC with an 8 GB NVIDIA card.

items.title: Wavefunction: a deliberately minimal desktop coding agent for Mac
items.summary: MIT-licensed and staying small while coding agents bloat, it runs multiple tasks in parallel with local models, your own API keys, or a ChatGPT sign-in — no provider lock-in.

items.title: Armiger: an 8 MB CPU-only neural classifier replaces regex rules in media stacks
items.summary: A community Apache-2.0 byte-level transformer (INT8 ONNX, ~2.5 ms/item on one CPU core) classifies BitTorrent/DHT metadata, catching disguised malware and fake-seeder honeypots, with drop-in Docker sidecars for the Sonarr/Radarr stack.

items.title: n8n patches 2.45.6/2.46.2 land on the 2.x line while 3.0 beta matures
items.summary: Bug-fix releases including an ai-builder fix that opens the self-healing chat in the resulting project; 2.x Community instances stay supported for 12 months after the 3.x stable lands in early December.

items.title: GPU Price Index: 22 tracked cards sell 2.8% below launch MSRP
items.summary: The videocardprices.com index stood at 97.2 on October 29 — but the snapshot lands amid a ten-country survey showing GPU prices up roughly 35% over three months during the memory shortage.

items.title: AMD FSR SDK 2.4 extends ML upscaling to Radeon RX 6000
items.summary: AMD keeps investing in ML inference kernels for RDNA2, extending machine-learning upscaling to the older series — good news for budget Radeon owners running local workloads.

items.title: Intel Moon Lake CPUs may bring four LPE cores to budget laptops
items.summary: A new report suggests the low-power core cluster aimed at sustained workloads could matter for on-device inference battery life in budget x86 laptops.
